changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE abac_scopes ( abac_scope_id bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, abac_scope_key varchar(50) NOT NULL, abac_scope_name varchar(50) NOT NULL, project_id bigint NOT NULL, -- REFERENCES project.project_id created_at datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by varchar(50) NOT NULL, updated_at datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by varchar(50) NOT NULL, is_deleted TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
UNIQUE(abac_scope_key, project_id) );

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda
changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO abac_scopes (abac_scope_id, abac_scope_key, abac_scope_name, project_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_deleted) SELECT scope_id, scope_key, scope_name, project_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_deleted FROM scopes WHERE access_control_model = 'ABAC';
UPDATE projects p LEFT JOIN abac_scopes s ON s.project_id = p.project_id SET p.default_scope_id_abac = s.abac_scope_id WHERE s.abac_scope_key = 'default_scope';

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE scopes DROP COLUMN access_control_model;
